name: stress-ng priv-instr
description: Start N workers that exercise various architecture specific privileged instructions that cannot be executed by userspace programs. These instructions will be trapped and processed by SIGSEGV or SIGILL signal handlers. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
